tool_input_args.name: command
tool_input_args.value:
python3 << 'EOF'
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, Alignment

wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Handbook Text"

# Header row
ws["A1"] = "Line"
ws["B1"] = "Extracted Text"
header_font = Font(bold=True, size=12)
ws["A1"].font = header_font
ws["B1"].font = header_font

# Read the extracted text
with open("/workspace/testbed/docs/handbook.txt", "r") as f:
    lines = [line for line in f.read().strip().splitlines() if line.strip()]

# Write each non-empty line
for i, line in enumerate(lines, start=2):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=i - 1)
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2, value=line.strip())

# Auto-adjust column widths
ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = 8
ws.column_dimensions["B"].width = 60

output = "/workspace/testbed/docs/handbook.xlsx"
wb.save(output)
print(f"Saved Excel file to {output}")
print(f"Rows written: {len(lines)}")
EOF
